decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical country and code-page interface definitions.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
BIOS, DOS and COMMAND modules include the file; it declares country/code-page information structures and NLS function constants.
The prior 774-byte DOS GETSET comparison found nine differences, all in marked NLS character or DosDseg address fields (review 071).
The prior COMMAND TENV comparison matched 546 non-relocation bytes and 31 internal branches at its inferred target location (review 153).
limitations: These comparisons support only selected uses of the structures; actual country data, all conditional configurations, final addresses and whole-file binary equality remain unverified.
